lede: Mountain Village Council votes Thursday on a resolution that sets the appreciation cap for deed-restricted units — the fine print that decides whether affordable housing actually stays affordable or quietly drifts out of reach. The same day, Telluride's Planning and Zoning Commission holds a public hearing on school district employee housing at the middle-high school site, and Ouray County's Planning Commission takes up three public hearings including a full repeal of a land-use code section. Back in town, HARC digs into the unpermitted Elks Lodge pergola and the Shandoka Lot redevelopment on Black Bear Road.

notable.stake: HARC decides whether to retroactively approve an unpermitted structure in the Historic District.
